rebecca_csm: Flagging Keystone Retail (trial) 10: onboarding progress stalled, usage dropped sharply. Only 9/50 seats active. Had a sync with the CTO and procurement yesterday.
omar_cs: Oof. Any error signals?
rebecca_csm: Yes — increased 5xxs during peak, and their QA saw model hallucinations on structured outputs. They called out latency as a blocker for batch ingestion flows.
liam_eng: I checked infra & model traces: region-eu-west-1 routed to a quantized variant that struggles with their long-context prompts. Also autoscaler flattened due to a misconfig in the pool min replicas.
nina_sales: Do they want alternative vendors? What did procurement say?
rebecca_csm: Procurement mentioned "looking at OmniServe and AtlasAI" and asked for a short latency/TCO comparison. CTO wants a performance proof before renewal talks.
omar_cs: We should propose a short remediation: 1) temporary model variant upgrade (non-quantized) 2) increase pool min replicas for 72h 3) provide a latency & cost delta doc + SLOs.
liam_eng: Feasible within 48h if legal signs a pilot addendum. I can draft the rollout steps and telemetry plan. ops-deploy-bot: Rolled back autoscale config at 2024-10-03T22:14Z (#5120).
elaine_legal: For pilot addendum we need scope, duration, and data handling notes. We can fast-track review in 24h if marketing/commercial terms are minimal.
nina_sales: I'll offer a 2-week dedicated trial with capped burst credits and ask procurement for their evaluation criteria. Also offer a joint perf call with engineering.
omar_cs: Action list: rebecca = coordinate CTO call + capture procurement criteria, liam = rollout plan + telemetry, nina = pilot terms + commercial, elaine = review addendum. Can everyone confirm by EOD?
rebecca_csm: Confirmed. Scheduling perf call for tomorrow 9:00 CET and exec recap Friday. I'll capture competitor criteria and attach to the one-pager. :white_check_mark:
